_comment: Declares the one Firebase resource this app uses: the Firestore security rules
that make the email allowlist real.
It is checked in because the rules are source, not settings -- they are the
thing an attacker would have to defeat, and a rule set that lives only in a
console textarea has no history and no review.
Deploying needs the Firebase CLI, which needs npm. Neither is installed on this
machine (node is present; npm and npx are not), so the rules are pasted into the
